summary_1line: Yudhishthira begins the Ashvamedha sacrifice; Arjuna follows the released horse across kingdoms, facing challenges from resentful rulers such as the Trigartas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna, bow Gandiva in hand and white horses yoked to his chariot, rides out behind the dark sacrificial horse as crowds of Hastinapura watch and cheer.
King Yudhishthira, wearing a golden garland and black deer-skin mantle, sits shining like fire upon the sacrificial altar surrounded by priests in ritual robes.
Arjuna stands in his chariot smiling calmly while armored Trigarta warriors surround the wandering sacrificial horse with drawn bows.
